text: Data will be generated at each of our institutional sites. The PI at each institution will be responsible for following the data management guidelines described below, and for saving the data to the RIC servers. This process of transferring all data to a central location will be facilitated by our research project coordinator. Our data management guidelines will be reviewed at the kickoff meeting for the project, and revisited briefly at each of our quarterly meetings with the PIs.

text: We will manage all scientific and technical content generated from this proposal. Our products will include 3 broad types of data.
label: answer.text

text: First, we will have data related to each of our proposed experiments. These will include the detailed protocols used for each experiment, the raw data collected from each experiment, and the experimental code used to collect those data.
label: answer.text

text: The relevant code will include both the data acquisition code, and the code for the controllers used in the experiment. Together, this information will be sufficient for recreating the circumstances of each data collection session.
label: answer.text

text: Our second type of data will be the code and results for all analyses completed on experimental data.
label: answer.text

text: Specifically, we store all code necessary to recreate figures, tables, and other results reported in all published manuscripts.
label: answer.text

text: The proposed foundational developments will produce substantial simulation code for controller development and testing. These and the outputs relevant to all key findings will also be managed.
label: answer.text

text: Data will be made available upon request, after the conclusion of each of study. The availability of data (raw and analyzed) will be advertised on the project’s website.
label: answer.text

text: Access will be free, but the original data collector/creator/principal investigator retains the right to use the data for analysis before making it publicly available.
label: answer.text

text: No patient identifying information will be included in any of the available data files.
label: answer.text

text: Select videos of the experiments will be distributed, with subject faces blurred so as to be unidentifiable.
label: answer.text

text: Experimental analyses results will be made available through peer-reviewed journal publications and conference presentations.
label: answer.text

text: The code needed to generate all published results will be documented clearly.
label: answer.text

text: Software generated under the project will be released under the GNU Public License, and available for free download on the labs’ websites.
label: answer.text

text: This includes code for each of our 3 experimental systems.
label: answer.text

text: We commit to speaking with any qualified scientist who wishes to discuss our results or the technology employed to obtain our results.
label: answer.text

text: There will be no copyright or licensing required for any of the data generated in this project.
label: answer.text

text: Research records will be archived for a minimum of seven years after final reporting or publication of a project.
label: answer.text

text: If any questions regarding the research, including but not limited to research integrity allegations, are raised during the seven- year retention period, the PI will keep the records until such questions are fully resolved.
label: answer.text

text: The servers at the Rehabilitation Institute of Chicago will serve as the central repository for all collected data.
label: answer.text

text: Raw data files will be saved in either Matlab or comma-separated value (CSV) format.
label: answer.text

text: Code for converting between these formats will also be provided to ensure easy access.
label: answer.text

text: The contents of each data file, including the experimental conditions or the analysis procedures used during generation will be documented.
label: answer.text

text: All raw data will be de-identified to ensure subject anonynimity.
label: answer.text

text: Upon request, data will be made available through the project's website, hosted on an archived server run by the RIC IT Team.
